about: Short, spoiler-free summaries for widely known imported works, written for Mimir and labelled on the site as AI-assisted readings awaiting editorial review. They let these works be indexed.

summaries.harry-potter-and-the-philosopher-s-stone: An orphaned boy learns on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard and is whisked away to a school of magic, where friendship and a hidden mystery await.
summaries.harry-potter-and-the-goblet-of-fire-2005: Harry is unexpectedly entered in a dangerous international wizarding tournament as the shadow of a returning dark power grows over his school.
summaries.harry-potter-and-the-deathly-hallows-par: The final chapter of the Harry Potter films: Harry, Ron and Hermione race to finish their quest as the battle for the wizarding world arrives at Hogwarts.
summaries.star-wars-episode-iv-a-new-hope-1977: A farm boy, a smuggler and a rebel princess join forces against a galactic empire and its planet-destroying weapon in the film that began the Star Wars saga.
summaries.star-wars-episode-v-the-empire-strikes-b: The Rebel Alliance is hunted across the galaxy while Luke Skywalker seeks a Jedi master, in the darker second chapter of the original Star Wars trilogy.
summaries.star-wars-episode-vi-return-of-the-jedi-: The rebels stage a bold plan to rescue a friend and strike at the Empire for good, while Luke faces his final trial.
summaries.star-wars-episode-i-the-phantom-menace-1: Two Jedi protect a young queen under siege and meet a gifted boy on a desert world, in the first chapter of the prequel trilogy.
summaries.star-wars-episode-ii-attack-of-the-clone: A growing separatist movement and a murder plot pull a Jedi apprentice and his master apart as a clone army appears.
summaries.star-wars-episode-iii-revenge-of-the-sit: As war grips the galaxy, a Jedi's loyalties are tested and the Republic's fate is sealed, closing the prequel trilogy.
summaries.star-wars-episode-vii-the-force-awakens-: Decades after the Empire's fall, a scavenger, a defector and a pilot are drawn into a new war between the Resistance and the First Order.
summaries.rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-2016: A band of rebels attempts a desperate mission to steal the plans of the Empire's ultimate weapon, just before the events of the original Star Wars.
summaries.titanic-1997: A young artist and a society girl fall in love aboard the ill-fated ocean liner in a romance and disaster epic that is also one of cinema's biggest hits.
summaries.gone-with-the-wind-1939: A headstrong Southern belle fights to survive the American Civil War and its aftermath in a sweeping Technicolor melodrama, a landmark of Hollywood's golden age that is also criticised for its romanticised view of slavery.
summaries.avatar-2009: A paralysed marine is sent to the moon Pandora, where he becomes torn between his orders and the alien people he comes to know.
summaries.skyfall-2012: James Bond must protect MI6 and its chief when a former agent's vengeful plot turns the past against the present.
summaries.e-t-the-extra-terrestrial-1982: A lonely boy befriends a stranded alien and tries to help it get home before the authorities close in.
summaries.the-avengers-2011: Earth's mightiest heroes must learn to work together when Loki and an alien army threaten the planet.
summaries.iron-man-3-2013: Tony Stark, shaken by past events, faces a terrorist threat known as the Mandarin and must rely on his wits more than his armour.
summaries.thor-2011: A powerful but arrogant god is banished to Earth, where he must prove himself worthy while his brother schemes for the throne of Asgard.
summaries.thor-ragnarok-2017: Thor is imprisoned on a distant planet and must escape to stop a death goddess from destroying his home, in a colourful, comic take on the myth.
summaries.ant-man-2015: A reformed thief is recruited to wear a suit that shrinks him to the size of an insect, for a heist that could save the world.
summaries.doctor-strange-2016: A brilliant but arrogant surgeon seeks healing after an accident and discovers a hidden world of magic and alternate dimensions.
summaries.captain-america-the-first-avenger-2011: A frail young man volunteers for an experiment in the Second World War and becomes a super-soldier fighting a secret Nazi science division.
summaries.captain-america-civil-war-2016: The Avengers split into two camps over government oversight, pitting old friends against each other.
summaries.guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-2-2017: The mismatched Guardians fight to keep their family together as the mystery of Peter Quill's father is revealed.
summaries.spider-man-homecoming-2017: A teenage Peter Parker balances high school with the lure of being an Avenger while he faces a salvage-business villain.
summaries.aliens-1986: Ellen Ripley returns to the planet where her crew met a deadly creature, this time with a squad of marines, in a tense sequel that leans into action.
summaries.the-jungle-book-2016: A boy raised by wolves must leave the jungle when a fearsome tiger threatens him, guided by a bear and a panther.
summaries.beauty-and-the-beast-2017: A bookish young woman trades her freedom for her father's and discovers kindness behind a cursed prince's temper, in a live-action retelling of the classic.
summaries.cinderella-2015: A kind young woman mistreated by her stepfamily finds help from a fairy godmother and a chance at a royal ball, in a live-action retelling.
summaries.the-incredible-hulk-2008: Scientist Bruce Banner searches for a cure to the condition that turns him into a powerful green giant while the military hunts him.
summaries.star-trek-the-motion-picture-1979: The Enterprise crew reunites to face a vast, mysterious energy cloud approaching Earth, in the first Star Trek feature film.
summaries.the-bfg-2016: A young girl in London meets a giant who catches dreams and blows them into the minds of sleepers, in a Roald Dahl adaptation.
summaries.lucy-2014: A woman accidentally dosed with an experimental drug begins to use ever more of her brain's capacity, in a fast-moving science fiction action film.
summaries.queen-of-katwe-2016: A girl from a Ugandan slum finds a path to becoming a chess champion through a mentor's guidance, in a family drama based on a true story.
summaries.doctor-who-1963: A mysterious time traveller called the Doctor and a changing circle of companions journey through time and space in a blue police box, in one of television's longest-running science fiction series.
summaries.star-trek-the-original-series-1966: Captain Kirk and the crew of the starship Enterprise explore the galaxy on a five-year mission, mixing adventure with ideas about humanity.
summaries.how-i-met-your-mother-2005: A father tells his children the winding story of how he met their mother, with his close friends in New York at its centre.
summaries.the-west-wing-1999: The staff of a fictional US president navigate politics, crises and their own lives in a fast-talking political drama.
summaries.the-x-files-1993: Two FBI agents investigate unexplained cases and a sprawling government conspiracy in a mix of horror, mystery and science fiction.
summaries.the-big-bang-theory-2007: A group of brilliant, socially awkward friends and their neighbour navigate science, love and geek culture in a long-running sitcom.
summaries.grey-s-anatomy-2005: Surgical interns and their mentors at a Seattle hospital balance life-and-death cases with romance and friendship.
summaries.modern-family-2009: Three related households, filmed in mockumentary style, show how loving and chaotic modern family life can be.
summaries.supernatural-2005: Two brothers travel America hunting ghosts, demons and monsters in a series that grows from horror stories into a sprawling mythology.
summaries.smallville-2001: The teenage years of Clark Kent in a Kansas town, as he learns about his powers before becoming Superman.
summaries.arrow-2012: A billionaire playboy returns from years of captivity and becomes a hooded vigilante to protect his city.
summaries.desperate-housewives-2004: Secrets, scandals and a mystery unfold behind the manicured lawns of a suburban street, narrated by a neighbour who is no longer there.
summaries.criminal-minds-2005: An FBI unit profiles offenders to anticipate and stop serial criminals.
summaries.law-order-1990: Each episode follows a crime and then its prosecution, split between detectives and district attorneys, in a long-running New York procedural.
summaries.ncis-2003: Agents of a naval criminal investigative service solve crimes involving members of the US Navy and Marine Corps.
summaries.csi-crime-scene-investigation-2000: Las Vegas forensic investigators follow the physical evidence to solve crimes, in the show that popularised the forensic procedural.
summaries.saturday-night-live-1975: A late-night live sketch comedy show with a rotating cast and a different celebrity host each week, in one of American television's longest-running programmes.
summaries.stargate-sg-1-1997: A military team travels through an ancient alien portal to other worlds, meeting allies and enemies across the galaxy.
summaries.supergirl-2015: Superman's cousin steps out of his shadow to protect National City while finding her own path as a hero.
summaries.er-1994: The doctors, nurses and staff of a busy Chicago emergency room face crises and personal storms in a long-running medical drama.
summaries.hawaii-five-0-2010: A special task force led by a former naval officer fights crime in Hawaii, in a modern reimagining of a classic police series.
summaries.the-silmarillion-1977: A collection of myths and legends from the First Age of Middle-earth, from the creation of the world to the forging of the rings, edited from J. R. R. Tolkien's writings.
summaries.the-lord-of-the-rings-1954: A hobbit inherits a ring of terrible power and sets out with a fellowship to destroy it, in the foundational epic fantasy by J. R. R. Tolkien.
summaries.all-quiet-on-the-western-front-1928: A young German soldier recounts the brutality and disillusionment of trench warfare in the First World War in Erich Maria Remarque's classic anti-war novel.
summaries.iliad--800: The ancient Greek epic of the Trojan War, centred on the anger of the warrior Achilles and its consequences.
summaries.the-divine-comedy-1320: Dante's epic poem describes his imagined journey through Hell, Purgatory and Paradise, a cornerstone of Italian literature.
summaries.the-decameron-1351: A hundred tales told by ten young people sheltering from the plague outside Florence, mixing comedy, romance and tragedy.
summaries.dream-of-the-red-chamber-1701: An eighteenth-century Chinese novel following the rise and decline of a grand aristocratic family, regarded as one of the country's four great classical novels.
summaries.water-margin-1400: A classic Chinese novel about 108 outlaws who gather at a mountain stronghold to resist corrupt officials.
summaries.the-romance-of-the-three-kingdoms-1350: A historical epic of the wars, alliances and betrayals that followed the fall of China's Han dynasty.
summaries.journey-to-the-west-1592: A monk travels to India to fetch sacred scriptures, protected by a mischievous monkey king and other companions, in one of China's great classical novels.
summaries.shahnameh-1000: The Persian poet Ferdowsi's epic of kings and heroes, tracing the legendary and historical past of Iran.
summaries.salem-s-lot-1975: A writer returns to his Maine hometown to find something sinister taking hold of its residents, in Stephen King's vampire novel.
summaries.divergent-2011: In a future Chicago divided into factions by personality, a teenager discovers she does not fit just one, in a young adult dystopian novel.
summaries.hallowe-en-party-1969: Hercule Poirot investigates a murder that follows a child's claim at a Hallowe'en party to have seen a killing.
summaries.pokemon-yellow-1998: A Pokémon adventure in which the player's companion is a Pikachu who follows them, a variation on the original Game Boy games.
summaries.pokemon-crystal-2000: A second-generation Pokémon role-playing game that adds new features and a story that revisits earlier regions.
summaries.pokemon-emerald-2004: The enhanced version of the Hoenn-region Pokémon games, with extra battle facilities and a revised storyline.
summaries.pokemon-platinum-2008: An expanded edition of the Sinnoh-region Pokémon games with a new Distortion World area, redesigned areas and extra post-game content.
summaries.league-of-legends-2009: A team-based online strategy game in which two squads of champions battle to destroy the other's base.
summaries.team-fortress-2-2007: A cartoonish team-based multiplayer shooter in which nine distinct classes compete in objective-based matches.
summaries.super-mario-bros-3-1988: A landmark platform game in which Mario and Luigi travel across worlds with new power-ups and an overworld map.
summaries.grand-theft-auto-iv-2008: An immigrant arrives in Liberty City hoping for a fresh start and is pulled into crime, in a grounded open-world game. Contains strong violence and language.
summaries.minecraft-dungeons-2020: A dungeon-crawling action game set in the Minecraft universe, playable alone or with up to four friends.
summaries.super-smash-bros-ultimate-2018: A crossover fighting game in which characters from many franchises battle on shared stages, with the largest roster in the series.
summaries.grand-theft-auto-san-andreas-2004: A young man returns to a fictional American state in the early 1990s and is drawn into gang life in a vast open-world game. Contains strong violence and language.
summaries.dota-2-2013: A multiplayer online battle arena in which teams of five heroes fight to destroy each other's ancient.
summaries.super-smash-bros-melee-2001: A fast, competitive crossover fighter that became a long-lived tournament favourite on the GameCube.
summaries.cyberpunk-2077-2020: An open-world role-playing game set in a dangerous, neon-lit megacity where the player is a mercenary pursuing a one-of-a-kind implant. Contains strong violence, language and sexual content.
summaries.sonic-the-hedgehog-1991: A fast-moving platform game in which a blue hedgehog races through colourful zones to stop a scientist's schemes.
summaries.half-life-1998: A scientist fights to survive when an experiment at a research facility goes wrong, in a first-person shooter known for telling its story without cutscenes.
summaries.the-sims-3-2009: A life simulation in which players guide the lives, careers and relationships of people in an open neighbourhood.
summaries.the-sims-2-2004: A life simulation in which characters age, form families and pursue aspirations across generations.
summaries.the-legend-of-zelda-twilight-princess-20: Link is drawn between the world of light and a creeping twilight in a darker entry in the Zelda series.
summaries.space-invaders-1978: A landmark arcade shooter in which the player defends against descending ranks of alien invaders.
summaries.subnautica-2014: A survival game in which the player crash-lands on an alien ocean world and must explore, build and escape its depths.
summaries.fire-emblem-three-houses-2019: A tactical role-playing game set at a monastic academy where the player teaches students from three rival houses before war breaks out.
summaries.grand-theft-auto-iii-2001: The first 3D entry in the open-world crime series, set in a fictional city, that changed what games could offer. Contains strong violence and language.
summaries.grand-theft-auto-vice-city-2002: An open-world crime game set in a 1980s-inspired Miami, with a vivid soundtrack and style. Contains strong violence and language.
summaries.warcraft-iii-reign-of-chaos-2002: A real-time strategy game that mixes base building with hero units, set in the world of Warcraft.
summaries.pokemon-go-2016: A mobile game in which players walk through the real world to find and catch Pokémon.
summaries.the-wall-1979: Pink Floyd's rock opera about isolation and the walls a person builds around themselves, one of the best-selling albums of all time.
summaries.a-night-at-the-opera-1975: Queen's grand, theatrical fourth album, which includes the multi-part 'Bohemian Rhapsody'.
summaries.the-beatles-1968: The Beatles' sprawling double album, often called the White Album, ranging across rock, folk, experimental pieces and ballads.
summaries.revolver-1966: The Beatles' studio-driven album that expanded their sound with tape effects, Indian instruments and more adventurous songwriting.
summaries.let-it-be-1970-album: The Beatles' final released album, drawn from sessions that aimed to return to a simpler live sound.
summaries.beatles-for-sale-1964: A mix of original songs and covers recorded by the Beatles at the height of their early fame.
summaries.hamilton-2015: The original Broadway cast recording of a musical about American founding father Alexander Hamilton, told through hip-hop, pop and show tunes.
summaries.reputation-2017: Taylor Swift's electro-pop album shaped by themes of public image, love and resilience.
summaries.dangerous-1991: Michael Jackson's album mixing new jack swing, pop and rock, including 'Black or White' and 'Remember the Time'.
summaries.the-freewheelin-bob-dylan-1963: Bob Dylan's second album, in which his own protest and love songs, including 'Blowin' in the Wind', established him as a major voice.
summaries.disintegration-1989: The Cure's lush, melancholic album of gothic rock, widely regarded as among their finest.
summaries.views-2016: Drake's album of moody hip-hop and R&B centred on Toronto.
summaries.19-2008: Adele's debut album of soulful pop with jazz and folk influences.
summaries.vulnicura-2015: Björk's album of strings and electronics charting the pain of a breakup.
summaries.tommy-1969: The Who's rock opera about a boy who becomes a pinball champion after losing his senses.
summaries.kiss-me-kiss-me-kiss-me-1987: The Cure's sprawling double album mixing pop, goth, funk and psychedelia.
summaries.history-past-present-and-future-book-i-1: Michael Jackson's double album pairing a hits collection with new material.
summaries.black-gives-way-to-blue-2009: Alice in Chains' album of heavy, harmony-driven rock, recorded after a long hiatus and with a new vocalist.
